SkyRoads (Bluemoon Interactive, 1993), from the decompilation at
https://skyroads.org: the game's own code, compiled for a RISC-V CPU that
runs in the FPGA, with the VGA screen, the AdLib (an OPL2), the Sound
Blaster's samples and the PC speaker as hardware next to it.

Controls: d-pad steer / accelerate / brake, A or Y jump, Start or X Enter,
B or Select Esc.
